facts.text: **Archery Premier League**: 15-second shot clock (20 s at World Cups). USA's **Casey Kaufhold** (Paris 2024 medallist) plays for Chero Archers with **Kumkum Mohod** (Asian Games champion) and **Atanu Das**.
